name: Jeremie Frimpong

career_stints.note: All competitions. Came through Manchester City's academy before a permanent move to Celtic in Sept 2019; won Young Player of the Year 2019/20 and part of a domestic treble-winning side.

All competitions across four and a half seasons. Frequently deployed as an advanced/inverted wing-back under Xabi Alonso rather than a conventional right-back -- share_of_minutes between RB/RW is an estimate, not a sourced split. Won the Bundesliga 2023/24 (unbeaten domestic treble year); 53 apps in 2024/25 as Leverkusen finished 2nd.

All competitions, debut Liverpool season after Liverpool triggered his ~€35m/£29.5m release clause. Missed roughly 20 games (5th-most of any Liverpool player) due to two separate hamstring injuries during the season.
